d: Long, wavy hair in a vibrant shade of crimson with bangs swept to the side. The eyes are a piercing crimson with a sharp, confident expression. The face is mature and elegant, appearing to be in their late twenties or early thirties, paired with a slender, tall build. The outfit consists of a floor-length, sleeveless black gown with a high thigh slit and silver spikes along the hip, layered under a voluminous crimson cloak. Accessories include a black floral hairpiece, multiple silver necklaces, gold rings, and black pointed heels with jagged, tooth-like detailing on the soles.
